about: Hardening configuration of the digital macro for pt_wired (split phase 2, decision D10): overrides of ../config.json; run_digital_hardening.sh with CHIP=wired merges them. One RTL, chip selected by the parameter PT_CHIP. Outline sized from synthesis (synth_area.sh, yosys, ss_032C_3v15 cells, no place and route): cell area 1.299 mm2 = 0.945 x the both-halves build (1.375 mm2), applied to the routed r8d macro (1716 x 1640 = 2.814 mm2 at 79.5 % utilisation): 1716 x 1553.76 um = 2.666 mm2 (hio_shift.py -11 rows). hio_shift.py -11 regenerates hio_placement.cfg and the clock-root placements for it. The ports of the other chip's blocks stay on the macro and are tied off at the chip top; the owner re-checks the pin order.
